newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Blow out vs the bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Blow out vs the bloc.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads widened sharply within the dollar bloc as local futures broke down through support, and in anticipation that there will be little joy for the market from this week's flurry of data.

Offshore selling of short-dated stocks consequently hit the whole curve and saw the March 10-year contract break last week's after hours low of 92.205 to make a new low for 1997 of 92.165 by 4.00 p.m. (0500 GMT).

While fourth quarter GDP is due for release on Wenesday, more emphasis is being put on Tuesday's January retail trade, given that it had been one of the weak sectors in the economy at the tail end of last year, and is generally expected to have rebounded.

U.S. Treasuries also weakened in Tokyo with the market remaining undermined by last week's hawkish comments by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan and ahead of this Friday's key non-farm payrolls report.
Spread movements were most notable against Canada, which benefitted from a fourth quarter GDP rise of just 0.7 percent on Friday when a 1.0 percent hade been forecast.
Local bonds also underperformed New Zealand, despite the market there giving up some of its firm tone with Australian debt and having firmed initially on a rebound in the N.Z. TWI.
